content.comment_body: Is it possible to connect [product_name] with the OPC UA standard?

Hello, currently there is no direct support for OPC UA with [product_name]. It only provides support for S7 and ModbusTCP protocols. In order to interface OPC UA, you will need a gateway that bridges S7/Modbus with OPC UA. [company_name] offers industrial gateways like [article_no] [product_name], the selection depends on whether your setup is private or commercial. All necessary functions for this connectivity are included. Alternatively, you could create a gateway using an IOT board such as IOT2040 from [company_name], which can run S7 and OPC libraries. Another option is to leverage cloud integration with [product_name] and forward data to AWS, from which it can be accessed by an OPC Server. Best regards, [user_name]
Yes, it is possible using Node-RED.
